company_info.description: RareJob Inc. provides reskilling-related and childcare support services for individuals, corporates, and educational institutions in Japan. It offers online English conversation services; educational services, such as courses, global leader development programs, and qualification support services; ALT dispatch services; and talent training for children and students, as well as offline English conversation classes. RareJob Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.
